label: Industrial Ingestion — Modbus TCP Client
info:
Industrial Ingestion — Modbus TCP Client (reference flow)

Reads 66 holding registers (FC3) from a Modbus TCP source, decodes the
Janitza UMG 96RM float32 layout (big-endian ABCD, base address 19000),
normalizes into the industrial ingestion envelope and publishes to the
Kafka Bronze ingestion topic. Read-only: no write path to the source.

Environment:
  MODBUS_HOST / MODBUS_PORT   source address (required; config node uses
                              ${MODBUS_HOST}/${MODBUS_PORT} substitution)
  MODBUS_UNIT_ID              unit id (default 1)
  MODBUS_POLL_MS              poll interval ms (default 5000)
  MODBUS_BASE_ADDRESS         first register (default 19000)
  MODBUS_DEVICE_ID            device id for envelope/key
  MODBUS_INGEST_TOPIC         Kafka topic (default modbus.ingest.raw)
  INDING_SITE_ID              site id for envelope
  INDING_KAFKA_BROKERS        broker list (required)

To point at a real PLC instead of the simulation fixture, change the
env vars only — no flow edit needed. Errors (connect/read, decode,
publish) go to the shared DLQ tab as typed envelopes; a failed cycle
never publishes a partial snapshot.
